sources.entry: bleak - A cross-platform Bluetooth Low Energy client for Python using asyncio.

summary.one_liner: Bleak is a cross-platform, asyncio-based Python GATT client library for connecting to and communicating with Bluetooth Low Energy devices.
summary.what_it_does: Bleak connects to BLE devices acting as GATT servers, such as sensors, from Python. It supports reading and writing GATT characteristics and receiving notifications. It also provides a BleakScanner.discover() function to find nearby BLE devices. The API is asynchronous (asyncio) and aims to work the same across Windows, Linux (BlueZ), and macOS (Core Bluetooth). An Android backend compatible with python-for-android is also mentioned. The README includes short examples for scanning and for reading the model number from a device by its UUID.
use_cases: Read sensor data from a BLE device in Python
Scan for nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices
Write values to a GATT characteristic on a BLE peripheral
Cross-platform Bluetooth communication from Python scripts
Connect to a TI SensorTag from Python
how_to_run: Run BleakScanner.discover() inside an asyncio coroutine to list nearby devices
Use 'async with BleakClient(address) as client:' to connect to a device
Call client.read_gatt_char(uuid) to read a characteristic
Do not name your script bleak.py (causes circular import error)
See the examples folder in the repository for more code
notable: Single asyncio API across Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android backends
Supports reading, writing, and notifications on GATT characteristics
Built-in BLE device discovery via BleakScanner
Acronym expands to Bluetooth Low Energy platform Agnostic Klient
caveats: Windows support requires Windows 11 build 22000 or greater
macOS support requires OS X 10.15 or newer
